papers.title: NCCN Guidelines® Insights: Colon Cancer, Version 3.2026
papers.journal_full: Journal of the National Comprehensive Cancer Network : JNCCN
papers.authors: Benson A, Venook A, Adam M, Ambelil M, Bray A, Chang G
papers.abstract: Colorectal cancer is the fourth most frequently diagnosed cancer and the second leading cause of cancer death in the United States. Treatment of localized disease usually includes surgery, sometimes followed by adjuvant systemic therapy, while advanced or metastatic disease is often treated with multiple lines of systemic therapy, based on biomarker status. These NCCN Guidelines Insights detail recent updates to the NCCN Guidelines for Colon Cancer, including recommendations for pretreatment DPYD testing to decrease the risk of severe fluoropyrimidine toxicity; updates to adjuvant therapy of nonmetastatic colon cancer based on the results of recent clinical trials; and a reorganization of the systemic therapies for advanced or metastatic disease based on biomarker status, highlighting changes to the treatment recommendations for BRAF V600E mutation-positive disease.

papers.title: Pilot prospective crossover study assessing the role of bile acid malabsorption in the causation and treatment of major low anterior resection syndrome: randomized clinical trial
papers.authors: Woodfield J, Clifford K, Thomas R, Richards S, Fowler A, Alquassab M
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Major low anterior resection syndrome (LARS) affects approximately 60% of rectal cancer survivors, causing urgency and decreased bowel control, reducing quality of life. Bile acid malabsorption (BAM) is an under-recognized contributor whose prevalence and treatment efficacy remain unclear. This proof-of-concept study evaluated the effectiveness of colesevelam for treating LARS and described the prevalence of BAM.
METHODS: This double-blind randomized placebo-controlled crossover trial was conducted between 2021 and 2024 in New Zealand. Adults aged 18-85 years with major LARS received colesevelam (up to 1.25 g, three times daily) or placebo for 5 weeks, separated by a 6-week washout period. A subset of patients underwent 75-selenium homocholic acid taurine (SeHCAT) testing for BAM. The outcomes of interest included changes in the LARS score, Fecal Incontinence Quality of Life Scale (FIQL), and Short-Form 12 (SF-12) questionnaire, with a composite outcome reflecting clinically important improvements.
RESULTS: Of 80 eligible patients, 49 were randomized. However, 36 patients completed the study after washout and were included in a per-protocol analysis (mean age 71 years; 69% male). In these 36 patients, colesevelam did not significantly improve LARS scores, but did significantly improve the SF-12 mental component summary (median +2.36; 95% confidence interval 0.00 to 10.25; P < 0.01) and FIQL depression/self-perception. Eight of 19 patients (42%) had BAM and exhibited significant improvements in SF-12 physical and mental item scores with colesevelam. Using composite criteria, colesevelam produced a 33% response rate, versus 8% for placebo, with higher rates in BAM-positive (50%) than BAM-negative (11%) patients.
CONCLUSIONS: BAM is a treatable contributor to LARS, present in 40% of tested patients. Although treating all LARS patients with bile acid sequestrants provides limited benefit, SeHCAT testing identifies patients likely to respond. BAM assessment would be beneficial if incorporated into LARS management.

papers.abstract_zh:
背景：重度低前位切除症候群（LARS）影響約60%的直腸癌存活者，造成便急與排便控制能力下降，降低生活品質。膽酸吸收不良（BAM）是尚未受到充分重視的促成因素，其盛行率與治療成效仍不明確。本概念驗證研究評估colesevelam治療LARS的效果，並描述BAM的盛行率。
方法：這項雙盲、隨機、安慰劑對照交叉試驗於2021至2024年間在紐西蘭進行。18至85歲的重度LARS成人接受colesevelam（最高每次1.25 g，每日三次）或安慰劑治療5週，兩個療程間設有6週洗除期。部分病人接受硒-75標記同膽酸牛磺酸（SeHCAT）檢查以評估BAM。關注的結果包括LARS分數、糞便失禁生活品質量表（FIQL）及12題簡式健康量表（SF-12）問卷的變化，並以一項複合結果反映具臨床重要性的改善。
結果：80名符合資格的病人中，49名接受隨機分派。然而，僅36名病人在洗除期後完成研究，並納入依計畫分析（平均年齡71歲；男性占69%）。在這36名病人中，colesevelam未顯著改善LARS分數，但顯著改善SF-12心理健康綜合分數（中位數增加2.36；95%信賴區間0.00至10.25；P < 0.01），以及FIQL的憂鬱／自我感受面向。接受檢查的19名病人中，8名（42%）有BAM，且使用colesevelam後，SF-12身體與心理項目分數均顯著改善。依複合判定標準，colesevelam的反應率為33%，安慰劑為8%；BAM陽性病人的反應率（50%）高於BAM陰性病人（11%）。
結論：BAM是LARS可治療的促成因素，在接受檢查的病人中約占40%。雖然對所有LARS病人使用膽酸結合劑的效益有限，但SeHCAT檢查可辨識較可能有治療反應的病人。將BAM評估納入LARS照護可能有益。

papers.title: Robotic versus laparoscopic transanal minimally invasive surgery (TAMIS) for rectal neoplasms: a systematic review, meta-analysis, and IDEAL framework mapping
papers.authors: Prete F, Prete F, De Luca G, Mongardini F, Rasool W, Gupta M
papers.abstract: Transanal minimally invasive surgery(TAMIS) enables local excision of selected rectal neoplasms. Robotic TAMIS(R-TAMIS) may overcome technical constraints of conventional laparoscopic TAMIS(L-TAMIS), but whether these capabilities translate into better outcomes remains uncertain. We compared R-TAMIS and L-TAMIS, examining the evidence in the context of robotic procedural maturity. PubMed, Scopus, and Cochrane Library were searched through 2026 for comparative studies of adults undergoing TAMIS for rectal neoplasm. Risk of bias, certainty of evidence, and procedural maturity were assessed using ROBINS-I, GRADE, and the IDEAL framework. Random-effects meta-analyses were performed. Six retrospective comparative cohorts including 314 patients were identified. R-TAMIS was associated with a higher likelihood of full-thickness resection (OR 11.77, 95%CI 1.40-98.85; P = 0.02), an outcome not appropriate for every lesion. R0 resection was comparable(OR 1.30, 95%CI 0.49-3.47; P = 0.60), with no significant differences in operative time, estimated blood loss, complications, conversion, readmission, or length of stay. Hospital costs tended to be higher with R-TAMIS(I²=99%). All outcomes were supported by very-low-certainty evidence. IDEAL assessment showed that R-TAMIS was introduced in centres with established L-TAMIS experience, while the robotic technique remained in an earlier phase of development. Comparative evidence shows broadly comparable outcomes. Difference in achieved excision depth requires confirmation using standardized outcome definitions and clinically appropriate case selection. These results were achieved despite greater procedural maturity of L-TAMIS and, in some cohorts, more challenging robotic case selection. This developmental asymmetry highlights the need to determine whether maturation and standardization of R-TAMIS will translate its technical capabilities into clinically meaningful advantages in appropriately selected, technically demanding lesions.

papers.title_zh: 機器人與腹腔鏡經肛門微創手術（TAMIS）治療直腸腫瘤：系統性回顧、統合分析與IDEAL架構定位
papers.abstract_zh: 經肛門微創手術（TAMIS）可用於局部切除經選擇的直腸腫瘤。機器人TAMIS（R-TAMIS）可能克服傳統腹腔鏡TAMIS（L-TAMIS）的技術限制，但這些能力是否能轉化為更好的臨床結果仍不確定。我們比較R-TAMIS與L-TAMIS，並從機器人術式成熟度的脈絡檢視證據。搜尋PubMed、Scopus及Cochrane Library截至2026年的文獻，納入成人因直腸腫瘤接受TAMIS的比較研究。使用ROBINS-I、GRADE及IDEAL架構，分別評估偏誤風險、證據確定性及術式成熟度，並進行隨機效應統合分析。共找到6個回溯性比較世代，納入314名病人。R-TAMIS與較高的全層切除勝算相關（OR 11.77，95% CI 1.40–98.85；P＝0.02），但全層切除並非適用於每一個病灶的結果指標。兩組R0切除結果相近（OR 1.30，95% CI 0.49–3.47；P＝0.60），手術時間、估計失血量、併發症、中轉、再住院或住院天數亦無顯著差異。R-TAMIS的醫院成本有較高趨勢（I²＝99%）。所有結果的證據確定性均為極低。IDEAL評估顯示，R-TAMIS是在已有成熟L-TAMIS經驗的中心導入，而機器人技術仍處於較早期的發展階段。比較證據顯示，兩種術式的結果大致相近。實際切除深度的差異，仍需透過標準化結果定義及臨床上適當的病例選擇加以確認。儘管L-TAMIS的術式成熟度較高，且部分世代中機器人組所選病例更具挑戰性，仍獲得上述結果。這種發展階段的不對稱性，凸顯有必要釐清：R-TAMIS在成熟與標準化後，是否能將其技術能力轉化為對經適當選擇、技術上具挑戰性病灶具有臨床意義的優勢。

papers.authors: Tan W, Liu L, Tang L, Huang R, Yuan Q, Cai S
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: Systematically evaluate the performance and methodological quality of predictive models for the risk of anastomotic stricture after rectal cancer surgery to provide evidence-based guidance for clinical practice.
METHODS: We comprehensively searched nine Chinese and English databases (CNKI, Wanfang, VIP, Sinomed, PubMed, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, CINAHL, and Embase) for relevant studies published until June 7, 2025. Two independent researchers screened the literature, extracted data, and assessed methodological quality using the Prediction Model Risk of Bias Assessment Tool (PROBAST).
RESULTS: Nine eligible studies were included, demonstrating AUC values ranging from 0.739 to 0.911 in derivation cohorts. Internal validation results were reported in three studies (AUC: 0.905-0.930), while two studies provided test-set validation (AUC:0.818-0.888). The most significant predictors included anastomotic leakage, the use of a protective stoma, and the anastomotic distance. All studies exhibited high risk of bias according to PROBAST criteria, primarily due to retrospective designs, inappropriate handling of continuous variables (dichotomization), inadequate sample sizes, improper management of missing data, univariate-based predictor selection, and insufficient model validation. However, two studies demonstrated good clinical applicability.
CONCLUSION: Research on predictive models for anastomotic stricture after rectal cancer surgery is still in its early stages, constrained by methodological flaws and a lack of external validation that limit their clinical applicability. Future studies should prioritize external validation across diverse populations to confirm their generalizability.

papers.abstract_zh:
目的：系統性評估直腸癌術後吻合口狹窄風險預測模型的表現與方法學品質，為臨床實務提供實證指引。
方法：全面搜尋九個中英文資料庫（CNKI、Wanfang、VIP、Sinomed、PubMed、Web of Science、Cochrane Library、CINAHL及Embase），納入截至2025年6月7日發表的相關研究。兩位研究者獨立篩選文獻、擷取資料，並使用預測模型偏誤風險評估工具（PROBAST）評估方法學品質。
結果：共納入九篇符合資格的研究，其模型建立世代的AUC介於0.739至0.911。三篇研究報告內部驗證結果（AUC：0.905–0.930），另有兩篇研究提供測試集驗證結果（AUC：0.818–0.888）。最重要的預測因子包括吻合口滲漏、使用保護性造口，以及吻合口距離。依據PROBAST標準，所有研究皆具有高偏誤風險，主要原因包括回溯性設計、連續變項處理不當（二分化）、樣本數不足、缺失資料處理不當、依單變項分析篩選預測因子，以及模型驗證不足。然而，有兩篇研究顯示良好的臨床適用性。
結論：直腸癌術後吻合口狹窄預測模型的研究仍處於早期階段，受到方法學缺陷與缺乏外部驗證的限制，影響其臨床適用性。未來研究應優先在不同族群中進行外部驗證，以確認其可推廣性。

papers.title: Urothelial Carcinoma in Lynch Syndrome: Clinical and Molecular Insights From a Large Multicenter Cohort
papers.authors: Schuler A, Engel C, Ahadova A, van Beekum K, Aretz S, Fechner G
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE: Lynch syndrome (LS), caused by pathogenic germline variants (PGVs) in DNA mismatch repair (MMR) genes, confers increased risks of colorectal, endometrial, and extracolonic malignancies. Urothelial carcinoma (UC) contributes substantially to LS-associated morbidity and mortality. We assessed its frequency, clinical presentation, genotype-associated risk, and molecular features.
METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed genetically confirmed adult LS carriers in the nationwide German Consortium for Familial Intestinal Cancer registry. UC diagnoses identified by International Classification of Diseases, 10th Revision codes C65-C68 underwent manual clinical and pathologic validation. Available tumors underwent centralized pathologic review, MMR immunohistochemistry, and microsatellite instability (MSI) testing.
RESULTS: Among 3,274 LS carriers, 144 (4.4%) had 224 primary UCs. The median age at first UC was 55 years (range, 22-79 years), and UC was the first malignancy in 50 patients (34.7%). Of 202 tumors with known location, 114 (56.4%) arose in the upper urinary tract. Metachronous and synchronous primary UCs occurred in 23 patients (16.0%) and five patients (3.5%), respectively. MSH2-associated PGVs were present in 111 patients (77.1%). In multivariable analysis, MSH2/EPCAM carrier status was associated with UC risk (hazard ratio, 4.43 [95% CI, 2.85 to 6.89]), whereas previous colorectal cancer and UC family history were not. Among 109 patients with diagnostic information, 26 (23.9%) presented with urinary tract-related symptoms, 20 (18.3%) were diagnosed incidentally, and 11 (10.1%) were diagnosed during urologic or oncologic surveillance. Of 31 lesions from 18 patients, 29 (93.6%) were mismatch repair-deficient (dMMR) and 30 (96.8%) were MSI-high; all patients had at least one dMMR tumor and at least one MSI-high tumor.
CONCLUSION: UC in LS occurs relatively early, is strongly associated with MSH2/EPCAM carrier status, and represents the first malignancy in one third of patients. These findings support prospective evaluation of genotype-adapted surveillance.

papers.title_zh: Lynch 症候群的尿路上皮癌：大型多中心世代的臨床與分子特徵
papers.abstract_zh:
目的：Lynch 症候群（LS）由 DNA 錯配修復（MMR）基因的致病性生殖系變異（PGVs）所致，會增加大腸直腸癌、子宮內膜癌及腸道外惡性腫瘤的風險。尿路上皮癌（UC）是造成 LS 相關罹病與死亡的重要因素。我們評估其發生頻率、臨床表現、基因型相關風險及分子特徵。
方法：我們回溯性分析德國全國性家族性腸癌聯盟登錄資料中，經基因檢測確認的成年 LS 帶因者。依國際疾病分類第十版代碼 C65–C68 辨識出的 UC 診斷，均經人工核實臨床與病理資料。可取得檢體的腫瘤接受中央病理複核、MMR 免疫組織化學染色及微衛星不穩定性（MSI）檢測。
結果：3,274 名 LS 帶因者中，144 人（4.4%）共有 224 個原發性 UC。首次罹患 UC 的年齡中位數為 55 歲（範圍 22–79 歲），50 名病人（34.7%）以 UC 作為首個惡性腫瘤。在位置已知的 202 個腫瘤中，114 個（56.4%）發生於上泌尿道。異時性及同時性原發性 UC 分別發生於 23 名（16.0%）及 5 名（3.5%）病人。111 名病人（77.1%）帶有 MSH2 相關 PGVs。多變項分析顯示，MSH2/EPCAM 帶因狀態與 UC 風險相關（風險比 4.43［95% 信賴區間 2.85–6.89］），但既往大腸直腸癌及 UC 家族史則無此關聯。在具有診斷相關資訊的 109 名病人中，26 人（23.9%）以泌尿道相關症狀表現，20 人（18.3%）為偶然診斷，11 人（10.1%）是在泌尿科或腫瘤科監測期間診斷。來自 18 名病人的 31 個病灶中，29 個（93.6%）為錯配修復缺陷（dMMR），30 個（96.8%）為高度微衛星不穩定（MSI-high）；所有病人均至少有一個 dMMR 腫瘤及一個 MSI-high 腫瘤。
結論：LS 病人的 UC 發生年齡相對較早，與 MSH2/EPCAM 帶因狀態高度相關，且約三分之一病人以 UC 作為首個惡性腫瘤。這些發現支持以前瞻性研究評估依基因型調整的監測策略。

papers.title: Resident mucosal programmes in colon cancer: organ-associated formation and remodelling of the immune niche
papers.authors: Jiang W, Pan B, Song Z, Zhang Z, Yan H
papers.abstract: Resident epithelial, immune and stromal cells organise immune responses in the colonic mucosa, but their contribution to the immune environment of colon cancer remains incompletely understood. We propose that colonic tumours may partly use pre-existing mucosal cells and regulatory mechanisms, a possibility we refer to as co-option. Chronic colitis provides a comparison for examining changes in mucosal immunity, without implying that inflammation is a necessary precursor to sporadic colon cancer. Colonic BTNL3/BTNL8 proteins regulate resident γδ T-cell subsets, and compartmentalised antigen presentation shapes local immune responses. In mouse models of colitis-associated cancer, resident stromal cells give rise to MCAM+ cancer-associated fibroblasts that promote macrophage recruitment through IL-34/CCL8 signalling. Tumour-associated immune changes include shifts in γδ T-cell subset composition and altered functions of RORγt+ regulatory T cells. MHC class II-dependent interactions between group 3 innate lymphoid cells and T cells also support microbiota-dependent antitumour immunity. Shared signalling is exemplified by the IL-22-oncostatin M-STAT3 pathway in experimental colitis and colitis-associated cancer. However, similarity in cell states and signalling does not establish that tumours preserve pre-existing multicellular mucosal niches. Much of the causal evidence derives from colitis-associated cancer models, and its relevance to sporadic colon cancer remains uncertain. Whether tumours use the same mucosal cells and regulatory mechanisms requires direct testing. Defining tumour-associated changes in these mechanisms may reveal therapeutic targets while preserving protective intestinal immunity.

papers.abstract_zh: 駐留的上皮細胞、免疫細胞與基質細胞共同組織結腸黏膜的免疫反應，但它們對結腸癌免疫環境的貢獻仍未完全釐清。我們提出，結腸腫瘤可能部分利用既有的黏膜細胞與調控機制；我們將這種可能性稱為挪用（co-option）。慢性結腸炎提供了檢視黏膜免疫變化的比較情境，但這並不表示發炎是散發性結腸癌的必要前驅因素。結腸的 BTNL3/BTNL8 蛋白調控駐留 γδ T 細胞亞群，而分區化的抗原呈現則形塑局部免疫反應。在結腸炎相關癌症的小鼠模型中，駐留基質細胞可衍生出 MCAM+ 癌症相關纖維母細胞，並透過 IL-34/CCL8 訊息傳遞促進巨噬細胞募集。腫瘤相關的免疫變化包括 γδ T 細胞亞群組成的轉變，以及 RORγt+ 調節型 T 細胞功能的改變。第3型先天淋巴細胞與 T 細胞之間依賴 MHC 第 II 類分子的交互作用，也支持依賴腸道菌相的抗腫瘤免疫。實驗性結腸炎與結腸炎相關癌症中的 IL-22–oncostatin M–STAT3 路徑，是兩者共用訊息傳遞的例子。然而，細胞狀態與訊息傳遞的相似性，並不能證明腫瘤保留了既有的多細胞黏膜微環境。許多因果證據來自結腸炎相關癌症模型，其與散發性結腸癌的相關性仍不確定。腫瘤是否利用相同的黏膜細胞與調控機制，仍需要直接驗證。釐清這些機制中與腫瘤相關的變化，可能有助於找出治療標的，同時保留具保護作用的腸道免疫。

papers.title: Postoperative Management After Curative-Intent Resection of Colorectal Liver Metastases: A Critical Review of Recent Randomized Evidence
papers.authors: Sagawa T, Hirakawa M, Nagashima H, Fujikawa K
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Postoperative management after curative-intent treatment of colorectal liver metastases (CRLM) remains controversial because improvements in recurrence-related outcomes have not consistently translated into longer overall survival (OS).
METHODS: This critical narrative review examines randomized evidence for systemic chemotherapy and hepatic arterial infusion (HAI), together with emerging evidence on circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA). Trial-based findings, prognostic associations, and unvalidated treatment-effect hypotheses were critically distinguished.
RESULTS: Postoperative fluoropyrimidine- or oxaliplatin-based treatment can delay recurrence in some settings, but a durable OS benefit has not been consistently demonstrated. Contemporary HAI trials differ in patient selection, regional drugs, systemic therapy, and endpoints. PACHA-01 reported improved hepatic recurrence-free survival in a selected population, HARVEST was terminated early, and PUMP did not meet its primary endpoint. These findings neither establish routine HAI nor identify validated predictors of benefit. Postoperative ctDNA is strongly prognostic, but nonrandomized associations between adjuvant treatment and outcomes cannot establish the clinical utility of ctDNA-directed treatment allocation.
CONCLUSIONS: A conceptual distinction between hepatic and systemic recurrence risk may support multidisciplinary deliberation and prospective trial design, but should not be used as a validated postoperative treatment-selection algorithm. Clinical decisions must also account for prior chemotherapy, postoperative recovery, toxicity, local treatment opportunities, institutional expertise, and patient preferences.

papers.title: Immune-mediated comorbidities in multiple sclerosis: a scoping review
papers.authors: Solak A, Riccio P, Seo D, Ayromlou S, Alanazi A, Racosta J
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Immune-mediated comorbidities are increasingly recognized in people with multiple sclerosis (PwMS), but their frequency, recorded diagnostic sequence, and clinical relevance remain incompletely characterized. We aimed to characterize their co-occurrence with MS, diagnoses following MS, associations with subsequently diagnosed MS, and relationships with MS clinical outcomes.
METHODS: We conducted a scoping review guided by the PRISMA-ScR checklist. PubMed, Embase, and Scopus were searched for studies published from January 1, 2001, through February 28, 2026. Eligible studies evaluated co-occurrence; immune-mediated diseases diagnosed following MS; associations between previously diagnosed immune-mediated diseases and subsequently diagnosed MS; or associations with MS activity, disability, or progression. Additional studies were identified through backward reference screening without publication-year restrictions.
RESULTS: Autoimmune thyroid disease, type 1 diabetes (T1D), psoriasis, inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), and bullous pemphigoid showed some of the most recurrent evidence of higher co-occurrence with MS, whereas findings for rheumatoid arthritis (RA), systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), vitiligo, atopic dermatitis, asthma, and less frequently studied conditions were more variable. Studies investigating immune-mediated diseases diagnosed following MS reported heterogeneous, condition-specific associations, with higher subsequent occurrence for psoriasis, IBD, and bullous pemphigoid in some populations. Studies examining previously diagnosed immune-mediated diseases and subsequently diagnosed MS reported higher estimates for selected conditions, including T1D, psoriasis, IBD, bullous pemphigoid, systemic sclerosis, and primary Sjögren's syndrome, although their magnitude, precision, and consistency varied. Evidence regarding associations between immune-mediated comorbidities and MS activity, disability, or progression was limited and heterogeneous. A small number of studies indicated adverse disability or MRI outcomes associated with T1D, whereas findings for other conditions were mixed, outcome-specific, or inconclusive.
CONCLUSION: Several immune-mediated diseases demonstrated recurrent co-occurrence with MS, while separate studies reported condition-specific associations with diagnoses following MS or with subsequently diagnosed MS. Findings varied across diseases, study designs, and temporal frameworks, and may indicate shared susceptibility, surveillance bias, diagnostic delay, treatment exposure, residual confounding, or coincidental coexistence. Current evidence is insufficient to establish an MS prodrome or biologically distinct MS subgroups. Longitudinal studies using standardized disease definitions, documented diagnostic chronology, treatment data, and appropriate confounder adjustment are needed to clarify clinical and prognostic relevance.

papers.title_zh: 多發性硬化症的免疫介導共病：範疇性回顧
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：免疫介導共病在多發性硬化症患者（PwMS）中日益受到重視，但其發生頻率、記錄中的診斷先後順序及臨床重要性仍未完全釐清。本研究旨在描述這些疾病與多發性硬化症（MS）的共存情形、MS診斷後出現的疾病診斷、與後續確診MS的關聯，以及與MS臨床結果的關係。
方法：我們依循PRISMA-ScR檢核表進行範疇性回顧。搜尋PubMed、Embase及Scopus，納入2001年1月1日至2026年2月28日發表的研究。符合資格的研究評估以下任一項目：疾病共存；MS診斷後確診的免疫介導疾病；先前確診的免疫介導疾病與後續確診MS之間的關聯；或與MS疾病活動度、失能或進展的關聯。另外透過回溯篩查參考文獻尋找其他研究，不限制發表年份。
結果：自體免疫性甲狀腺疾病、第1型糖尿病（T1D）、乾癬、發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）及類天疱瘡，是與MS較高共存頻率之證據較反覆出現的疾病；類風濕性關節炎（RA）、全身性紅斑性狼瘡（SLE）、白斑症、異位性皮膚炎、氣喘及較少被研究的疾病，其結果則較不一致。探討MS診斷後確診免疫介導疾病的研究，呈現異質且因疾病而異的關聯；部分族群在後續出現乾癬、IBD及類天疱瘡的頻率較高。探討先前確診免疫介導疾病與後續確診MS的研究，在部分疾病中呈現較高的關聯估計值，包括T1D、乾癬、IBD、類天疱瘡、全身性硬化症及原發性乾燥症，但其關聯幅度、精確度及一致性各不相同。免疫介導共病與MS活動度、失能或進展之間關聯的證據有限且具異質性。少數研究指出，T1D與較不良的失能或MRI結果有關，其他疾病的研究結果則不一致、因結果指標而異，或尚無定論。
結論：數種免疫介導疾病呈現反覆被觀察到的與MS共存現象；另有研究指出，MS診斷後的其他疾病診斷，或後續確診MS，存在因疾病而異的關聯。研究結果隨疾病、研究設計及時間架構而異，可能反映共同易感性、監測偏差、診斷延遲、治療暴露、殘餘混雜或偶然共存。目前證據不足以確立MS前驅期或生物學上不同的MS亞群。未來需要採用標準化疾病定義、記錄診斷時間順序、納入治療資料並適當調整混雜因子的縱向研究，以釐清其臨床及預後意義。

papers.title: Systematic review and best evidence summary of patient positioning management in the modified lithotomy position during laparoscopic colorectal surgery
papers.authors: Sang J, Zhao G, Zhang Y, Li J, Zhao M
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To systematically retrieve and summarize the best available evidence on patient positioning management for the modified lithotomy position in laparoscopic colorectal surgery, in order to provide an evidence-based reference for standardizing positioning practices.
METHODS: Guided by the 6S evidence model, we searched resources such as UpToDate, BMJ Best Practice, the National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) website, the Registered Nurses' Association of Ontario (RNAO) website, and the International Guideline Network for relevant clinical decisions, guidelines, evidence summaries, expert consensuses, systematic reviews, and meta - analyses. The search period for guidelines, evidence summaries, and expert consensuses spanned from database inception to October 7, 2025, while systematic reviews were restricted to those published between January 1, 2020, and October 7, 2025. The retrieved literature was appraised for quality, and evidence was extracted and synthesized.This study was registered with the Fudan University Evidence-Based Nursing Center (registration number: ER20259536).
RESULTS: 17 publications were included, from which 18 best - practice evidence points were summarized across five domains: preoperative assessment, positioning procedure, positioning - related complications, postoperative handover, and education/training. This summary offers evidence - based guidance on patient positioning in the modified lithotomy position for laparoscopic colorectal surgery, intended to support clinical practice.

papers.title: Differentiation of stem-like CD4+ T cells modulates early effector responses in colorectal cancer
papers.authors: Zhang Y, Nie H, Dai Z, Zhao L, Wan Y, Wang Y
papers.abstract: Strategies to improve cancer immunotherapy have largely focused on the intratumor immunosuppressive microenvironment, whereas approaches to amplify peripheral T cells and promote tumor recruitment have not been thoroughly explored. Using imaging mass cytometry in patients with colorectal cancer (CRC), we observed T helper 1 (TH1)-like immune architectures in mismatch repair-deficient tumors associated with response to anti-programmed cell death protein 1 (PD-1) immunotherapy. By contrast, mismatch repair-proficient (pMMR) tumors showed regulatory T-dominant spatial interactions. Clonal analyses revealed that stem-like CD4+ T cells differentiated into TH1-like cells after PD-1 blockade. In pMMR CRC mouse models, combined OX40 agonist and PD-1 blockade suppressed tumor progression by expanding Il7r+ early effector CD4+ intermediates in tumor-draining lymph nodes, promoting migration and connection with TH1-like cells. This was accompanied by interferon-γ-dependent induction of immunostimulatory monocyte-macrophages and CD8+ effector T cells. These findings suggest that leveraging peripheral CD4+ T cell amplification may improve immunotherapy responses.

papers.title: siRNA-mediated mismatch repair disruption synergizes with oxaliplatin to restore immune surveillance in microsatellite-stable colorectal cancer
papers.authors: Ni J, He G, Wang H, Qin Y, Guo J, Wang Y
papers.abstract: Proficient mismatch repair/microsatellite-stable colorectal cancer (pMMR/MSS CRC), which represents the majority of clinical cases, exhibits low tumor mutational burden and minimal responsiveness to immune checkpoint blockade. Disrupting the MMR system has been shown to resensitize pMMR/MSS CRC to immune surveillance; however, direct MMR inhibitors are currently unavailable. Here, we bridge this gap by developing small interfering RNA lipid nanoparticles (siMMR@LNPs) capable of silencing key MMR genes, including MLH1, MSH2, and MSH6, achieving over 70% gene silencing in both subcutaneous and hepatic metastatic tumor models of pMMR/MSS CRC. A synergetic strategy combining siMMR@LNPs with oxaliplatin substantially bolsters tumor mutational burden, thereby expanding the tumor mutation-derived neoantigenic peptide repertoire in pMMR/MSS CRC and promoting CD8+ T cell infiltration and activation. This combinatorial regimen effectively inhibits tumor progression in pMMR/MSS CRC across both subcutaneous and liver metastasis mouse models, showing potential to reinstate immune surveillance in the immunotherapy-refractory pMMR/MSS CRC. This approach may offer a viable route to develop a promising immunotherapy for pMMR/MSS CRC.

papers.title: Laparoscopic versus open surgery for sphincter preservation in mid- and low rectal cancer: a large propensity score-matched cohort study
papers.authors: Zheng H, Xu Y, Lv M, Zhou C, Guo T, Zheng C
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Recent studies have suggested that laparoscopic surgery for rectal cancer yields postoperative complications and long-term survival rates comparable to those of open surgery. Nevertheless, whether sphincter-preserving rates are equivalent between laparoscopic and open approaches remains a topic of debate.
METHODS: This retrospective study included patients with mid- and low-rectal cancer who underwent open or laparoscopic surgery at Fudan University Shanghai Cancer Center (2006-2021). Propensity score matching (PSM) was used to balance baseline characteristics. Sphincter-preserving rates and short- and long-term outcomes were compared.
RESULTS: Data from 9405 rectal cancer patients were collected. After propensity score adjustment, 7738 patients (4993 open and 2745 laparoscopic) with mid- and low- rectal cancer were included. The sphincter-preserving rates were 60.7% in the open surgery group and 72.3% in the laparoscopic surgery group, corresponding to an odds ratio (OR) of 1.70 (95% CI 1.53-1.88, P < 0.001) in the PSM cohort. Subgroup analyses showed that higher sphincter-preserving rates were associated with laparoscopic surgery across different tumor positions. In a sensitivity analysis using multivariable logistic regression in the full unmatched cohort, the adjusted OR was 3.11 (95% CI 2.69-3.59) for laparoscopic versus open surgery. Regarding long-term outcomes, the laparoscopic group had 5- year overall and disease-free survival rates of 77.0% and 76.6% respectively, which were comparable to those of 75.2% and 74.5% for the open surgery group (P = 0.09 and P = 0.20).
CONCLUSIONS: For mid- and low-rectal cancer, laparoscopic surgery was associated with higher sphincter-preserving rates than open surgery after PSM, with comparable long-term prognoses.

papers.title_zh: 中低位直腸癌保肛手術之腹腔鏡與開腹比較：大型傾向分數配對世代研究
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：近期研究顯示，直腸癌腹腔鏡手術的術後併發症與長期存活率與開腹手術相近。然而，腹腔鏡與開腹手術的保肛率是否相當，仍有爭議。
方法：本回溯性研究納入於復旦大學附屬腫瘤醫院接受開腹或腹腔鏡手術的中低位直腸癌病人（2006–2021年）。使用傾向分數配對（PSM）平衡基線特徵，並比較保肛率及短期與長期結果。
結果：共收集9405名直腸癌病人的資料。經傾向分數調整後，納入7738名中低位直腸癌病人（開腹4993名、腹腔鏡2745名）。在PSM世代中，開腹組與腹腔鏡組的保肛率分別為60.7%與72.3%，對應的勝算比（OR）為1.70（95% CI 1.53–1.88，P < 0.001）。次群組分析顯示，在不同腫瘤位置中，腹腔鏡手術均與較高保肛率相關。在針對完整未配對世代使用多變項邏輯斯迴歸的敏感度分析中，腹腔鏡相較於開腹手術的調整後OR為3.11（95% CI 2.69–3.59）。長期結果方面，腹腔鏡組的5年整體存活率與無病存活率分別為77.0%與76.6%，與開腹組的75.2%及74.5%相近（P分別為0.09與0.20）。
結論：對中低位直腸癌而言，PSM後腹腔鏡手術與較開腹手術更高的保肛率相關，且長期預後相近。

papers.relevance_why: 直接涉及台灣大腸直腸外科常見的中低位直腸癌術式選擇與保肛諮詢。
papers.one_liner: 7738名中低位直腸癌病人中，腹腔鏡較開腹保肛率高（72.3% vs 60.7%）。
papers.action: 目前不需改變做法；中低位直腸癌保肛決策仍依腫瘤與功能條件，勿將此相關性當成術式因果效果。

pico.P: 單一中國癌症中心2006–2021年手術病人；收集9405人，傾向分數調整後納入7738名中低位直腸癌病人。
pico.O: 核心結果為保肛率；另比較短期及長期結果，摘要報告5年整體存活率與無病存活率，未明示主要／次要終點層級。

cautions: 回溯性且跨16年；選案與年代混雜可能影響保肛率，PSM不保證消除。

保肛不等於功能良好；存活差異未顯著不代表已證實等效。
unassessable: PSM納入變項、配對比例、卡尺、共同支持範圍及配對後平衡程度。

短期併發症、切緣、局部復發、永久造口、LARS及生活品質結果。

papers.context: 前兩篇所列研究比較機器人與腹腔鏡直腸癌手術，本篇則補上腹腔鏡與開腹在保肛率上的比較；不同術式對照不能直接串成優劣排序。先前研究的3年RFS與本篇5年無病存活皆未見顯著差異，但不能因此認定術式等效；第三篇僅為計畫書，尚無結果可對照。
